# AI-augmented foundations

> Whether the family's setup is complete and whether it converges: what a tree or graph of topics can encode, a computed cost of a tree that no study has validated, and when a project stops at an acceptable result. Three principles, each with its grade.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Expressiveness: what a tree of topics holds and costs

- [A computed cost with provisional weights](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/principles/expressiveness/computed-cost.md): the cost of a tree of topics is computed by a program, every weight is tagged PROVISIONAL, and no one ranks trees by it until a reader study has validated it.
- [Links beside the tree](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/principles/expressiveness/links-beside-the-tree.md): a relation the tree of topics does not hold is a typed link beside it, and a tree plus m minus n plus c such links encodes any finite graph.

## Convergence: when a project stops

- [Stop at acceptable, with the optimum as a bound](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/principles/convergence/stop-at-acceptable.md): a project stops when a written criterion of done passes and the gap to the optimum is within a tolerance stated beforehand; the optimum is a bound, not a goal.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each

## Reviews

- [Bayesian optimisation](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/bayesian-optimisation/README.md): a project as the optimisation of an unknown objective, the choice of the next step, the stop that follows, and a worked model on the family's own runs
- [Worked model](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/bayesian-optimisation/worked-model.md): the family's runs as evaluations, with the policy each would choose

## Design

- [The guide](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/design/guide.md): a project as a sequential decision problem under an unknown objective, the field's solutions mapped onto the family's setup, a guide designed to propose and never decide, and the verdict not to build it yet
- [The trace](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/design/trace.md): every job of the family's first two days, with kind, cost and outcome
- [The replay](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/design/replay.md): which next step each policy would have proposed on the trace, and where the value of information stops
